name: D & O Green Technologies Berhad
overview: 2026年可获取的公告主要为公司治理、股东大会及季度业绩相关事项，未披露各业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订等具体业务动态。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比下滑5.2%，净利润为负。
overview_en: The announcements available for 2026 mainly relate to corporate governance, general meetings and quarterly results; no specific business developments such as expansion, new business, reduction, disposal or contract wins were disclosed for the business segments. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue declined 5.2% year-on-year and net profit was negative.
